answer: Proposal 'delaychain': each identity must extend a personal VDF chain from the beacon seed all epoch; only unbroken chains earn. Sequential evaluation cannot be split, so N aliases need N evaluators running continuously, a chip k times faster serving at most k. Cost is linear in rented hardware, holding while per-identity epoch reward stays below one evaluator's rental. Gaps break freshness: a swarm cannot doze like lotus seeds then sprout; hollow registrations earn zero. Assumption: no covert speedup—the chain ticks like a quartz oscillator, and faster hidden silicon is the open flank.
